name: City of Gods 2026
about: City of Gods is the Gothic Folly condensed for a night outdoors between two buildings: a portal of five main arches around a 16-petal rose window with 7 rings of cells, one mini arch each side, and two towers at the front, each a scaffold box carrying a spire of 8 globe strands, a quad arch on three faces and flood-lit spirelets (10 in all). No canopy and no ground wash.
